data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small gross reserve release of GBP 0.557 million for prior underwriting years, primarily driven by favorable claims development for the 2015 year of account. The 2016 year of account showed no change in its reserve estimate during 2017. While prior years (2015 and 2016) had incurred significant losses from natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria) and large man-made losses, the overall reserve estimates for these years developed slightly favorably in 2017.
